records_cursor.$comment: Authority-owned canonical base64url JSON [created_at_ms,payment_id], ordered by created_at_ms DESC then payment_id ASC; clients echo unchanged.

payment_cards.$comment: complete live set per owner; at most 2 open cards, then recent terminal cards in remaining slots. A new checkpoint at capacity gets PAYMENT_CHECKPOINT_ACTIVE (409), never evicts a live card. Maximum 3-card envelope is 17823 bytes; 2 cards fit the 12288-byte transport limit without reducing any field cap.

payment_approvals.$comment: complete pending set per owner, at most 2. A new request at capacity gets APPROVAL_BUSY (409), never evicts a pending approval. Bound matches the complete card snapshot.

payment_records.$comment: complete records packed by serialized envelope size <= 12288 and requested limit. next_before is a lossless authority-owned cursor, including the payment_id timestamp tie-breaker.

payment_record.$comment: complete timeline events paged by immutable audit event sequence, newest page first and each page chronological. Echo next_seq as before_seq to reach older events; no history is discarded. Short continuation name preserves existing field caps within 12288 bytes.
